wholePhysicalScope: The complete five-part Gedhong Panggung exterior, three island terraces and their attached exterior approaches circa 1859.
lodDetails: All four levels retain the three prominent roofs, low gallery links and stepped terraces. Nearby views add deep sills, guard posts, paired stairs and raised tile seams.
limitations: The circa-1859 reconstruction covers Gedhong Panggung and its immediate terraces. The neighboring pavilions, bath complex, tunnels and former lake are outside the exterior scope.
The measured provincial survey fixes the room sizes, story levels and lower terrace dimensions. Roof pitches, tile shades, stair runs, ground level and the upper terrace outline are approximations.

The historic building is aligned to the provincial register coordinate and the surviving map outline. The independent ground review uses modern source heights. Historic water level and vertical registration are unknown.
